Name: Daulton and Maple - Nyapu's Style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
Soooo, in my autism ways, I decided to start a new save for that safe feeling of routine and thought to add some new mods to the mix, that was this morning...Anyway, here's the handsome Daulton and the adorable Maple in Nyapu's style (to the best of my abilities)!!!

This is a download and replace the images mod, so you know the drill:
1. Unzip the file
2. Copy the images in said file
3. Go to "Mods\Daulton and Maple Custom NPC\assets\Portraits" and paste the images
4. Press replace files and you're done!

Enjoy!

Daulton and Maple are by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bigsquishy0]bigsquishy0[/url]
The Portraits are based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]
